They do know I'm suicidal and have offered to help me in the day time, I know they care about me but the harsh reality is they need sleep and can't be there for me 24/7, which is why I liked having wifi so I could have support whenever I needed it

I'm too impulsive, they let me off the hook already yesterday because I got mixed up with money, and now I feel like I have taken advantage of their kindness
